_comment: Client settings for the GridMats Solar Walkway proposal template. Copy _new-client.json, fill it in, then run build/build.sh <file-name-without-.json>.
tariff_category: HT-II Commercial (assumed; confirm from the RCP electricity bill)
tariff_note: Avoided daytime cost on MSEDCL HT-II Commercial: energy + wheeling after the solar-hour ToD rebate (MERC order, 25 Mar 2026). About ₹7.1 if the campus is billed HT-I industrial.
tariff_source: MSEDCL HT-II, MERC order 25 Mar 2026; confirm from bill
why_points: Office roofs carry HVAC, water tanks and access; walkways are open sky that is paved anyway.
Employees and visitors walk on the power plant every day: Reliance's Net Carbon Zero 2035 goal, made tangible.
Every tile is metered and sensed: a live data feed that can plug into JioThings and the campus IoT stack.
25 m², low-voltage DC, built in days; decide on rollout with three months of measured data.
site_requirements: A sunny 12-14 m stretch of walkway, about 2 m wide, with little shade from 9 am to 4 pm
A low-voltage connection point within about 30 m (distribution board or lighting panel)
Permission for a 2-3 day installation window and a safety induction
A Jio facilities contact for monthly readings and the 3-month review
deck_tagline: A 25 m² pilot walkway that generates power on the Jio campus
